item.description: The View.__getattr__ method has flawed logic for handling reserved names. It raises AttributeError for any underscore-prefixed attribute that exists in the layout, regardless of whether it should be accessed via indexing or attribute access. This causes failures when accessing valid reserved fields through attribute access.
item.contract: When accessing a field with an underscore prefix via __getattr__, the method should only raise AttributeError if the field name exists in the layout AND the field is a reserved name that should only be accessed via indexing. Otherwise, it should proceed with normal attribute access.

item.description: The _convert_to_int method in Layout class doesn't properly validate reset values for UnionLayouts. It fails to distinguish between valid and invalid cases when processing reset values for UnionLayout initialization.
item.contract: The _convert_to_int method should properly validate that UnionLayout reset values contain at most one field and raise ValueError with appropriate error message when multiple fields are specified.

item.description: The UnionLayout.const method has incorrect handling of mapping and sequence inputs for reset values. It raises ValueError incorrectly when it should accept valid inputs or raise appropriate errors.
item.contract: The const method should properly process mapping and sequence inputs for UnionLayout resets and raise appropriate errors for invalid cases (e.g., multiple fields specified).

item.description: The StructLayout members property setter doesn't properly validate inputs during assignment. This leads to incorrect error handling when invalid field names or shapes are provided.
item.contract: The members setter should validate that field names are strings and field shapes are shape-castable objects, raising appropriate TypeError exceptions for invalid inputs.

item.description: The View.__getitem__ method doesn't provide proper error messages for array layout indexing with invalid types or accessing non-existent fields. Error messages are insufficient or missing.
item.contract: When indexing array layouts with invalid types, it should raise TypeError with clear message. When accessing non-existent fields, it should raise KeyError with appropriate message.
